Games

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at SevenLions. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

Things I’ve made:

CAST IRON LIFE

A boardgame and half-formed flash game based on the American Civil War.  I’ve heard many times that it is a terrible name, but until someone comes up with a better one, then we’re all stuck.

Flash Version

Rulebook for the Boardgame Version

Things I’ve contributed to:

Bughunter

An attempt to fit every 80s sci-fi action movie into a browser-based game.  Written in php by a guy who has nothing better to do than help me out with various silly digital projects.

If you look closely, you can see a tiny communist standing next to a tiny spaceship.

XConq

An open-source strategy game engine based loosely on the old Empire.  I worked on this project, primarily building games but also modifying the main engine, for several years.

XConq running my game "Opal" which was a messy Master of Magic clone.
